description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class for verifying tenant timeout behavior in a client factory related to Eclipse Hono. It contains test methods that check whether tenant-specific links are closed upon timeout events, using Vert.x and Mockito for asynchronous testing and mocking.

classes.name: AbstractTenantTimeoutRelatedClientFactoryTest
classes.description: An abstract test class providing tests for tenant timeout link management in client factories.

methods.name: getClientFuture
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a Future of client type T given a connection and tenant ID.

methods.name: testLinksCloseOnTenantTimeout
methods.description: Tests that links are closed when a tenant timeout message is received for the client’s tenant.

methods.name: testDontCloseLinksForOtherTenants
methods.description: Tests that links are not closed when a tenant timeout message is received for a different tenant.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates and configures a mock HonoConnection with stubbed methods, used in tests.
